boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Mary Washington
boards.description: Ten Fredericksburg food destinations with currently published evening hours; check the linked business page before heading out.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 5325 Jefferson Davis Highway
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm service and order options, then plan a breakfast, pickup, or delivery stop at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A nearly round-the-clock option for breakfast and diner food.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists this Fredericksburg location as open from 12 AM to 11:58 PM every day and describes it as serving breakfast 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily store hours of 12 AM–11:58 PM; pickup and delivery are offered.

cards.title: Hashtag Gyro And Subs
cards.subtitle: 11330 Patriot Highway
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s ordering options and posted hours, then use the carryout or delivery window for a late food run.
cards.short_summary: A casual gyro, sub, burger, and fried-chicken restaurant open through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Hashtag Gyro And Subs lists its Fredericksburg restaurant, carryout, and delivery hours as ending at midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists restaurant, carryout, and delivery service through midnight every day.

cards.title: El Ultimo Trago
cards.subtitle: 9969 Patriot Highway
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s location page to confirm the day’s closing time, then plan a dine-in or food-focused group meal.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant with a posted midnight Saturday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: El Ultimo Trago lists Fredericksburg hours until 10 PM Sunday–Wednesday, 11 PM Thursday–Friday, and midnight Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site posts closing at 10 PM Sun–Wed, 11 PM Thu–Fri, and midnight Sat.

cards.title: Legends Grille
cards.subtitle: 10500 Spotsylvania Avenue
cards.notes: Check the day’s posted closing time and use the restaurant’s ordering link if a pickup plan works better than dining in.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly American restaurant with late weekday and weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Legends Grille identifies itself as family-friendly and lists hours until 11 PM Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 AM–11 PM Mon–Thu, 11 AM–midnight Fri–Sat, and 11 AM–10 PM Sun.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Fredericksburg
cards.subtitle: 4220 Plank Road
cards.notes: Confirm the current operating day first, then choose dine-in, carry-out, drive-thru, or delivery before the 10 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service option with multiple official service modes through 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists its 4220 Plank Road location’s dine-in, carry-out, drive-thru, and delivery hours as 6 AM–10 PM Monday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists all service modes until 10 PM Mon–Sat; the restaurant is closed Sunday.

cards.title: Texas Roadhouse Fredericksburg
cards.subtitle: 3940 Plank Road, Suite A
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s waitlist or to-go option and confirm the day’s hours before making a later dinner plan.
cards.short_summary: A full-service dinner stop open until 11 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Roadhouse lists its Fredericksburg location open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday, and until 10 PM Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11 PM closes Fri–Sat and 10 PM closes Sun–Thu.

cards.title: Castiglia's Italian Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 324 William Street
cards.notes: Check the dinner window before setting out, and use the restaurant’s stated take-out option if you need a shorter stop.
cards.short_summary: Downtown Italian dining with an 11 PM Friday and Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Castiglia's lists hours until 10 PM Monday–Thursday and until 11 PM Friday and Saturday, with take-out available.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists closing at 10 PM Mon–Thu and 11 PM Fri–Sat; Sunday closes at 9 PM.

cards.title: Mi Rancho Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 3400 Plank Road
cards.notes: Confirm whether it is a Friday or Saturday, then choose dine-in, takeout, or the restaurant’s listed reservation option.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Mi Rancho lists its Fredericksburg location as open until 10 PM Sunday–Thursday and until 11 PM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site posts 10:30 AM–10 PM Sun–Thu and 10:30 AM–11 PM Fri–Sat for the Fredericksburg location.

cards.title: Fahrenheit 132
cards.subtitle: 318 William Street
cards.notes: Reserve or confirm the evening schedule before leaving, especially for a Friday or Saturday dinner that runs to 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant with later Friday and Saturday dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fahrenheit 132 lists hours of 4–10 PM Sunday–Thursday and 4–11 PM Friday–Saturday at 318 William Street.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant page lists 4–11 PM Friday–Saturday and 4–10 PM Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Vocelli Pizza Fredericksburg
cards.subtitle: 7008 Salem Fields Boulevard
cards.notes: Check the official ordering page for the current day’s close, then place a pickup or delivery order before the listed 11 PM end time.
cards.short_summary: A pizza option with a published 11 PM closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Vocelli Pizza’s Fredericksburg site lists the 7008 Salem Fields Boulevard restaurant as open from 10 AM to 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official location site lists an 11 PM close; confirm the current day’s availability when ordering.
